body:
PR-3196 / TASK-2606 integration seat report (claude-integrator-01). STAGED, NOT MERGED. Nothing published.

Verified 2026-11-01 ~07:25Z:
- PR-3196 OPEN, not draft, head c541bd8cfa72b56ddb8ac7968191ba3f3c4a8ca0 (unchanged).
- Independent APPROVE at that exact head: gate-ledger PR-3196.jsonl#7, reviewer seat, grant 46c266c7, session 01a195e3. This seat (session 01a195fb) is not in the authorship trail.
- Build (ubuntu-latest) and every CI shard passed on c541bd8c. merge-hold-gate passed on its latest two runs (07:14Z, 07:16Z); the earlier 06:55Z failure came from the label, before the release.
- Holds: no marker in primary .aida/merge-holds/. Labels are merge-hold-recorded + merge-hold-cleared. Ledger seq 8-10 shows auto-release:verdict with the audit comment posted.
- main = 53c89700b4d (TASK-2631). The PR head is 1 behind main (diverged 3/1), so aida pr ship refuses by design. The sanctioned path is the one-member train, aida pr train 3196.

Why I did not land it:
1. aida pr train 3196 --dry-run refused the member: 'a live drive owns it (drive seat ...)'. This seat runs with AIDA_HEADLESS=1, which probe_ship_drive_block treats as a drive seat. I did not unset it and did not use AIDA_PR_SHIP_ALLOW_IN_DRIVE, because either would bypass a gate.
2. This seat's sandbox mounts .git read-only (AIDA_CONTAINED=1), so the train's fetch/push cannot run here anyway.
3. The live merge owner is the serial-ship in /tmp/aida_runme.sh (PR-3182, then PR-3190; both still OPEN). I did not start a second runner.

Handoff for the integration owner, after the serial runner finishes:
  aida pr train 3196 --dry-run   (confirm head is still c541bd8c, the approval holds and there are no holds)
  aida pr train 3196             (one-member train: patch-id carry-over + CI on train/*)
Run it from a non-headless, uncontained merge seat (operator terminal / runner). Main will move when 3182/3190 land. The train rebuilds on the new main. If the patch-id changes because of a conflict, the train drops the member, and the PR then needs rework plus a fresh review.

After MERGED, AC6 (publication), per docs/showcase/README.md:
  git worktree add TMPDIR/ghp origin/gh-pages
  python3 docs/showcase/publish.py --rev <merged main sha> --out <empty dir>
  replace the gh-pages files with that output; commit with the revision in the message; push gh-pages
  verify https://joemooney.github.io/aida/authority.html is served; publish.py --rev <sha> --compare <ghp worktree>
Keep TASK-2606 closure:pending until the authority page is publicly served from the merged revision.
subject: PR-3196 staged: not merged (behind main; train blocked from headless/contained seat)
